name: Beta 1.0.54
notes: Retraining: any specialist team can retrain into a new role and pick one of three new quirks (points come back as free points, perks reset, 10 minutes off the job). Price is a quarter of its hire cost and doubles with each paid retrain. The planet the station parks at gets a free retrain, and planets left badly short of ships after a move get Priority Training at 75% off; the parking forecast flags them
